Price 3,000 gp; Slot none; Weight —

A data spike holding the Lock Tree's engineering drawings, hand-drawn by a dead Technic League engineer. Celmak did not write it, so it is immune to the honeypots. Plugged into any reader, it grants a +5 bonus on checks to find, disable or understand the Dimensional Anchor Array. Afterward, it grants a +2 bonus on checks against any Androffan dimensional anchor, which may matter at Silver Mount.

Found in: Episode 2 (Lot 4). Vlathherex bids on this and nothing else.
